name: mm_BldgClaims_EvalA
notes: the building's claim spreads to its neighbours: over the 13 x 13 weight grid (every other tile) each building first met there, and the objects stacked on it, with the same claim (flag and id), above the low threshold and not maxed, get their meter raised by weight x spread step; at 0xFF it maxes out (flag 0x40, hold time); a claim rising a band costs a point of approval

name: mm_BldgClaims_EvalB
notes: draws the building's claim: each section B entry weighs its value among the nearby buildings (mm_BldgClaims_CountNearby; id 0x32 weighs its start value while the building has no entrance), one is drawn by weight as the claim slot and timer, a need not at its start value marks the building (flag 2)

name: mm_BldgClaims_CountNearby
notes: the value of a claim entry (flag, id or section D group, start value, reach) among the buildings of its tile lists overlapping the rectangle: a need counts down from the start by each building's section C value (0 once met), a wish counts up (cap 0xFF)

name: mm_BldgClaims_EvalC
notes: checks whether the claim is met (nothing missing nearby): flag 8, approval +3, sound and minimap mark; else meter handling

name: mm_BldgClaims_EvalD
notes: weighs the building's claims against its neighbours': the table at 0x1F4B90 sums, per claim, the weights and weighted meters of the neighbours holding it; the heaviest wins: the building's own claim moves its meter towards their average by half a step, another is taken when the meter is low enough (switch factor)

name: mm_BldgClaims_Evaluate
notes: per building: claim check (part C), meter rise by the rate, part D above the low threshold, flag 0x40 above 0xFE

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecSendToIop
notes: (audioDecSendToIOP) in preset or play state, sends as much PCM as fits behind the SPU2 AutoDMA play position (sceSdRemote 0x8100) in 1 KB units

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecIsPreset
notes: (audioDecIsPreset) true once the IOP buffer has been filled the first time

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecEndPut
notes: (audioDecEndPut) commits a1 bytes; in header state collects the 0x28-byte SShd/SSbd header first and prints it

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecBeginPut
notes: (audioDecBeginPut) free space as up to two areas: the header area while parsing it, else the EE ring (0xC000 bytes)

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecReset
notes: (audioDecReset) stops AutoDMA, records the play position, plays the zero buffer, clears all counters

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecStart
notes: (audioDecStart) full volume and starts AutoDMA looping over the IOP buffer, state 2 (play)

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecResume
notes: same as mm_Movie_AudioDecStart, used after a pause

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecDelete
notes: (audioDecDelete) frees the IOP buffers

name: mm_Movie_AudioDecCreate
notes: (audioDecCreate) EE ring a1/a2, allocates the IOP buffer (a3 bytes) and a 0x800-byte zero buffer on the IOP

name: mm_Movie_DisplayStop
notes: clears the display-running flags (0x1BDD68, 0x1BDD9C)

name: mm_Movie_DisplayStart
notes: waits for the field a0 to pass, then sets the display-running flag

name: mm_Movie_DmaEndHandler
notes: (handler_endimage) DMA interrupt handler: releases the shown picture (mm_Movie_VoBufDecCount)

name: mm_Movie_VblankHandler
notes: (vblankHandler) VSync interrupt handler: picks the buffer by the GS CSR field bit, swaps, sends the next decoded picture and subtitles

name: mm_Movie_LayoutSubtitle
notes: lays out a subtitle string into glyph indices at 0x215F00 using the font

name: mm_Movie_BuildSubtitlePacket
notes: builds the subtitle GS packet at 0x20C1A0 from the laid-out glyphs (font glyphs, positions)

name: mm_Movie_SendFrame
notes: sends the current picture and the subtitle packet to the GS (path 2 DMA, A+D setup)

name: mm_Movie_BuildImagePacket
notes: turns a decoded RGB32 picture into a textured-sprite GS packet (strips, A+D registers)

name: mm_Movie_ClearScreen
notes: clears both display buffers to black, swapping on vsync, reading the pad meanwhile

name: mm_Movie_PlayPss
notes: (playPss) opens the PSS (cdrom0:), initialises, then pumps the demux and audio until the movie ends or a button skips it ("QuickView:%s")

name: mm_PlayMissionMovie
notes: plays DATA\MPEG\MISSION<n>.PSS with its .BIN subtitles (n = a0), or ENDING.PSS for 6, once the sound driver is idle

name: mm_PlayOpeningMovie
notes: plays DATA\MPEG\OPENING.PSS at 640x448 once the sound driver is idle

name: mm_Movie_SetSubtitleState
notes: 0x1BDD80 = a0

name: mm_Movie_Error
notes: (ErrMessage) prints "[ Error ] %s"

name: mm_Movie_SwitchThread
notes: (switchThread) RotateThreadReadyQueue syscall (0x2B)

name: mm_Movie_TermAll
notes: (termAll) waits for the decoder to drain, stops audio, removes the handlers, deletes the threads and closes the stream

name: mm_Movie_Update
notes: one step of playback: pumps the demux until the decoder reports the end, then terminates

name: mm_Movie_ReadAndDemux
notes: reads disc data into the read buffer (sceCdStRead), demuxes it (sceMpegDemuxPssRing), sends audio to the IOP and starts display and audio once both are preloaded

name: mm_Movie_ResumeAll
notes: restarts display and audio after a pause

name: mm_Movie_InitAll
notes: (initAll) display buffers, sceMpegInit, video decoder, audio decoder (when 0x1BD9E8 is set), stream callbacks, read and decode threads, VSync and DMA handlers

name: mm_Movie_PcmCallback
notes: (pcmCallback) stream callback for audio: skips the 4-byte sub-stream header, copies the packet into the audio decoder (ring-aware); returns 0 when there is no room

name: mm_Movie_VideoCallback
notes: (videoCallback) stream callback for video: copies the packet into the IPU input buffer, records its time stamp ("pts buffer overflow"); 0 when there is no room

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufEndGet
notes: (readBufEndGet) releases a1 bytes

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufBeginGet
notes: (readBufBeginGet) start of the readable data and its size

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufEndPut
notes: (readBufEndPut) commits a1 written bytes

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufBeginPut
notes: (readBufBeginPut) write position unless the ring is full

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufDelete
notes: (readBufDelete) empty

name: mm_Movie_ReadBufCreate
notes: (readBufCreate) empty ring of 0x50000 bytes

name: mm_Movie_StrFileRead
notes: (strFileRead) sceCdStRead of a1/2048 sectors (or sceRead for host files); flags a read error

name: mm_Movie_StrFileClose
notes: (strFileClose) sceCdStStop and frees the stream buffer (or sceClose)

name: mm_Movie_StrFileOpen
notes: (strFileOpen, was mm_OpenDiscFile) cdrom0: files via sceCdSearchFile and CD streaming, host0: files via sceOpen

name: mm_Movie_ViBufGetTs
notes: (viBufGetTs) time stamp of the data the IPU is reading now

name: mm_Movie_ViBufPutTs
notes: (viBufPutTs) records a time stamp for the data just written

name: mm_Movie_ViBufModifyPts
notes: drops time stamps whose data the IPU has consumed

name: mm_Movie_ViBufFlush
notes: (viBufFlush) rounds the write offset up to 2 KB

name: mm_Movie_ViBufCount
notes: (viBufCount) bytes waiting for the IPU

name: mm_Movie_ViBufDelete
notes: (viBufDelete) stops IPU DMA, deletes the semaphore

name: mm_Movie_ViBufRestartDma
notes: (viBufRestartDMA) restarts the toIPU DMA where it stopped

name: mm_Movie_ViBufStopDma
notes: (viBufStopDMA) stops the toIPU DMA and remembers its position

name: mm_Movie_ViBufAddDma
notes: (viBufAddDMA) queues more ring data on the toIPU DMA chain ("DMA ADD not active")

name: mm_Movie_ViBufEndPut
notes: (viBufEndPut) commits a1 bytes

name: mm_Movie_ViBufBeginPut
notes: (viBufBeginPut) free space as up to two areas

name: mm_Movie_ViBufReset
notes: (viBufReset) empties the ring and the time stamp table, builds the DMA tags

name: mm_Movie_ViBufCreate
notes: (viBufCreate) ring a1 (uncached), DMA tag area, time stamp table, semaphore

name: mm_Movie_CbTimeStamp
notes: (mpegTS) libmpeg time stamp callback: mm_Movie_ViBufGetTs

name: mm_Movie_CbRestartDma
notes: (mpegRestartDMA) libmpeg callback

name: mm_Movie_CbStopDma
notes: (mpegStopDMA) libmpeg callback

name: mm_Movie_CbNoData
notes: (mpegNodata) libmpeg callback: switch threads, then queue more input

name: mm_Movie_CbError
notes: (mpegError) libmpeg callback: prints the message

name: mm_Movie_DecodeLoop
notes: (decBs0) decode thread loop: sceMpegGetPicture into the picture queue, builds image and subtitle packets, ends on sceMpegIsEnd ("decode thread: aborted")

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecMain
notes: (videoDecMain) decode thread entry: resets the buffers, runs the loop, waits for the queue to drain, state 3 (done)

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecIsDone
notes: input buffer empty and libmpeg has no more pictures

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecPutTerminator
notes: appends a sequence end code (0x1BD9F0) to the input once there is room; 0 until then

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecPutTs
notes: (videoDecPutTs) time stamp for input offset a3

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecGetState
notes: (videoDecGetState) +0xA8

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecDelete
notes: (videoDecDelete) deletes the input buffer and the sceMpeg (0x10BF60)

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecEndPut
notes: (videoDecEndPut) commits a1 bytes of input

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecBeginPut
notes: (videoDecBeginPut) input free space as up to two areas

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecAddStrCallback
notes: wrapper around sceMpegAddStrCallback; returns 1

name: mm_Movie_VideoDecCreate
notes: (videoDecCreate) sceMpegCreate, the five libmpeg callbacks, state 0, input buffer

name: mm_Movie_VoBufDecCount
notes: (voBufDecCount) one shown picture released

name: mm_Movie_VoBufGetTag
notes: (voBufGetTag) oldest decoded picture (0x39240-byte slots), 0 if none

name: mm_Movie_VoBufGetData
notes: (voBufGetData) next free picture slot (0x12C000 bytes each), 0 if full

name: mm_Movie_VoBufIncCount
notes: (voBufIncCount) marks the slot decoded and advances

name: mm_Movie_VoBufIsFull
notes: (voBufIsFull) count == size

name: mm_Movie_VoBufReset
notes: (voBufReset) empties the queue

name: mm_Movie_VoBufDelete
notes: (voBufDelete) empty

name: mm_Movie_VoBufCreate
notes: (voBufCreate) picture data a1, tag area a2, a3 slots

name: mm_Words_MatchTypedAnswer
notes: which answer of the current question matches the typed text (strcmp)

name: mm_Words_GetEntryDefault
notes: default text for a name entry question

name: mm_Words_GetEntryMode
notes: (provisional) first field of the name entry question (passed to mm_NameEntry_Setup)

name: mm_Words_GetChoiceText
notes: text of menu choice a3 for code a2: goods with prices ("Don't buy"), claims, wants, events

name: mm_Words_ApplyChoice
notes: stores menu choice a3 for code a2 (bag item, want, event, argument) and jumps

name: mm_Words_CountChoices
notes: number of menu choices for code a2

name: mm_Words_AppendClipped
notes: (provisional) appends a string to the message buffer within the line limit

name: mm_Words_ExpandLine
notes: expands a script line: conditions pick branches, text getters fill in names, actions run

name: mm_Words_StepImpl
notes: binds the loaded tables on first use, then runs codes until the next message or end code

name: mm_Words_Step
notes: next message of the running script (to mm_Words_StepImpl)

name: mm_Words_FriendshipChanged
notes: global context +0x13C

name: mm_Words_CancelAllowed
notes: global context +0x130

name: mm_Words_LoadForWants
notes: script for a wants window line (event or default), reads its block

name: mm_Words_LoadForFamily
notes: script for family a1 member a2 (talk by phone), reads its block

name: mm_Words_LoadForPerson
notes: script for person a1 (may start an event), reads its block

name: mm_Words_ReadBlock
notes: reads a script block from the open WORDS file into the buffer

name: mm_Words_OpenFiles
notes: opens DATA\BIN\WORDS.BIN and WORDSEVE.BIN for streaming

name: mm_Words_Init
notes: loads the WORDS, WORDSEVE, WORDSCOM and WORDSTEN tables at game start

name: sdk_scf_BcdToTime
notes: converts the six BCD time fields (frombcd), used by AdjustTime

name: sdk_scf_TimeToBcd
notes: converts back to BCD (tobcd), used by AdjustTime

name: sdk_kpatch_AlarmInsert
notes: kernel patch: inserts into the sorted alarm list (0x80076740, count 0x80076700)

name: sdk_kpatch_SetAlarm
notes: kernel patch: SetAlarm, up to 64 alarms on timer 0x10001800

name: sdk_kpatch_ReleaseAlarm
notes: kernel patch: ReleaseAlarm

name: sdk_kpatch_AlarmSetCompare
notes: (provisional) kernel patch: programs the timer compare and syncs

name: sdk_kpatch_AlarmHandler
notes: kernel patch: timer interrupt, runs due alarms

name: sdk_kpatch_SetTlbEntry
notes: (provisional) kernel patch: maps or unmaps a TLB entry (Wired)

name: sdk_kpatch_CopyOsdConfig
notes: (provisional) kernel patch: copies 0x26 bytes of OSD config into kernel RAM

name: sdk_kpatch_ResetHardware
notes: (provisional) kernel patch: waits for the timer interrupt, then resets through kernel calls

name: sdk_kpatch_TerminateThreads
notes: (provisional) kernel patch: terminates and deletes threads 1..255

name: mm_StaticInit_StatusBytes
notes: constructs the 256 status bytes at 0x1F32F0

name: mm_StaticInit_WordsTable
notes: copies the WORDS member function table template (0x1B1B48) to 0x1B9100

name: mm_StaticInit_Words
notes: constructs the WORDS object (0x1BDDF0) and registers its destructor
